spec_text:
Build a CLI (normalize.py, Python 3) that reads CSV from stdin, lowercases a
"status" column, trims whitespace on all columns, drops rows where "id" is empty,
and writes CSV to stdout. Reject (exit 2) if required columns (id, status) are
missing. Include a pytest file with at least 3 cases. Deliver as a pinned repo:
https://github.com/owner/repo@<commit>.
name: CSV schema normalizer
